en: A vintage black-and-white postcard showing an urban street scene in Graz, Austria. The image captures a street lined with classic European buildings with shuttered windows. A shop labeled 'Marie Hofer.' is visible on the corner, with people standing in front. On the right, a stately building dominates the scene, and in the background, a dome can be seen, suggesting an important public building nearby. The postcard has printed text identifying the location and a department.
